doc.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Soundtracks for Quincy Jones and Sidney Poitier films
summary: She identifies her three film songs including For the Love of Ivy and A Dandy in Aspic, and the title If You Want Love.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Yes, with Quincy that we cleared that up. We didn‘t clear it up, we just figured out Quincy‘s relationship as a producer.
Yeah.
After that, though, he was instrumental, he and Sidney Poitier, in you doing two soundtracks, I believe, For the Love of Ivy . . .
Yeah, I did two, three.
. . . and A Dandy in Aspic. You did a third one?
[sings notes] That was one, two, three, three, three, yes.
Do you recall the third one?
[sings] These are [unclear] necklaces, [sings notes]. Yeah, all three of them I remember. Yes.
The actual title of the third one? Because I don‘t know that one.
If you want love, if you want love and . . . wait a minute. Don‘t promise anything except to try love. I‘m going to tell you . . . can we get back to that?
Sure, sure. Well, there are two that I know of. I was just wanting to ask you . . .
Which two do you know? Maybe . . .
For the Love of Ivy, that was the movie with Abbey Lincoln.
Yeah, The Love of Ivy.
And A Dandy in Aspic.
Yes.
Those are the two that I know of.
And the other one is [sings notes] A Dandy in Aspic is. The third one, If You Want Love in A Dandy in Aspic, and . . .
Oh, that‘s the title, If You Want Love?
Yeah. [sings] If you want love, yeah. Okay. [laughs] Thought a dirty something. See, the guys, we‘re in the studio and they‘re talking dirty and stuff. [laughs] And I remember.
Oh, what they were talking about.
Oh yes, oh yes.
